fnol_text: My name is Lucia Santos and I live at 373 Foxglove Court, Madison, WI 53729. You can reach me on (555) 211-5724 or lucia.santos@example.com. Our house was broken into on 17 April 2025. The back door was forced and a laptop, jewellery and a television were taken. Policy HH-2024-00030. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Santos on (555) 211-5724 to acknowledge the claim. Lucia confirmed the loss date as 17 April 2025.
Site visit to 373 Foxglove Court. Neighbour Tomas Brennan was present and confirmed the timeline.
